# Burnworth Co.

> Founder-led web development, SEO and AI search visibility for service businesses.
> Run by Brandon and Zenande Burnworth. Every engagement is delivered by the people who plan it.
> Based in Oceanside, California (San Diego County). Works with contractors across the United States.

## Services

- [Web Development, SEO & AI Visibility](https://burnworthco.com/services): Web development and SEO for businesses that need a fast website and a clear plan to get found. GEO and AEO are included in every SEO package.
- [Web Development Services](https://burnworthco.com/web-development): Custom web development for service businesses. Get a fast, mobile-ready website with clear content, technical SEO, analytics, and launch support. Burnworth Co. designs and builds new websites, full redesigns, landing and sales pages, and speed and mobile fixes; request a website build estimate at https://burnworthco.com/web-development#estimate.
- [SEO for Contractors](https://burnworthco.com/contractor-seo): Contractor SEO from a two-person studio in Oceanside, CA. Service pages, Google Business Profile, project proof and lead tracking, from $1,000 a month.
- [SEO for Flooring Companies](https://burnworthco.com/seo-for-flooring-companies): SEO for flooring contractors, installers and showrooms. Separate pages for refinishing and installation, service areas backed by real jobs, and tracked calls.
- [AI Search Optimization: GEO, AEO and AI SEO Services](https://burnworthco.com/ai-search-optimization): Generative engine optimization (GEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO) for contractors and local service businesses: getting a business named, cited and described correctly in ChatGPT and Google’s AI answers. Included in every SEO package. Also called AI SEO, AI search optimization or LLM SEO.
- [SEO & AI Visibility Audit](https://burnworthco.com/search-visibility-audit): Find crawl problems, missing service content and gaps in Google and AI visibility. Get a prioritized action plan tied to qualified inquiries.
- Paid ad campaigns: planned, built and managed alongside the SEO work, so paid and organic search point at the same service pages. See https://burnworthco.com/services#more.
- [GEO and AEO: Generative and Answer Engine Optimization](https://burnworthco.com/generative-engine-optimization): Generative engine optimization (GEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO) in plain English: what they mean, GEO vs. SEO vs. AEO, the other names (AI SEO, LLM SEO), and how to show up in ChatGPT and Google’s AI answers.

## Price and terms

- SEO programs run $1,000 to $4,000 a month, depending on how many services you want to target and the package you choose.
- GEO (generative engine optimization) and AEO (answer engine optimization) are included in every SEO package. Neither is sold as an add-on.
- Audits are free.
- Website builds run $2,000 to $5,000, depending on the number of pages and services.
- Programs are planned for six months. The minimum is two months; after that you can cancel anytime. After six months it goes month to month. We recommend staying on, because SEO compounds with consistent work.
- You own everything: the website, domain, Google Business Profile, analytics and content. If you leave, we transfer it all to you.
- No ranking guarantees.

## Research and writing

- [State of Search 2026](https://burnworthco.com/research): A sourced briefing on AI search adoption, zero-click behavior, citations, measurement, and the 2027 visibility strategy.
- [AI Visibility Should End in a Phone Call](https://burnworthco.com/ai-visibility-business-results): A field note connecting search and AI visibility to calls, estimates and client-reported business demand.

## Work

- [Website & Search Projects](https://burnworthco.com/work): Explore Burnworth Co. client projects in flooring and broadcast equipment rental, and the business questions behind the website and search work.
- [Top Tier Custom Floors Project](https://burnworthco.com/work-top-tier-custom-floors): Website and local-search project context for Top Tier Custom Floors, a Valley Center flooring business serving San Diego County.
- [LA Production Company Website](https://burnworthco.com/work-los-angeles-production-company): Website project context for a Los Angeles-based production company providing robotic camera and motion systems for production.
- Client-reported result: Top Tier Custom Floors went from a website that had never produced a job to roughly three to four calls and estimate opportunities per week within two months of the SEO work, according to owner Stone Peters. As of November 2026 the business reports landing 6 to 10 jobs a month. Not a guarantee for other businesses.
